mechanistic_hypothesis: The v0.4 two-sided edge-level partial removes genuine shared-boundary signal from the held-out target. Geometry-induced private-boundary bias only requires removing the shared nuisance component from the predicted field exposure; the raw held-out target should remain untouched.

candidate_definitions.prediction_propensity_only: Spearman correlation between prediction rank residualized against geometry-only private propensity rank and raw held-out turnover rank
candidate_definitions.prediction_length_and_propensity: Spearman correlation between prediction rank residualized against edge-length and private-propensity ranks and raw held-out turnover rank
candidate_definitions.target_propensity_only: Spearman correlation between raw prediction rank and target rank residualized against private-propensity rank
candidate_definitions.two_sided_propensity_only: partial Spearman after removing private-propensity rank from both prediction and target
candidate_definitions.v04_two_sided_length_and_propensity: locked v0.4 two-sided partial with length and private propensity controls

selection_rule: Select the first candidate in preference order that passes the Wilson precision requirements on BOTH failed development panels: maximum zero-shared two-sided Wilson 95% upper bound across amplitudes 0.5,1,2,3 <= 0.10 AND full-shared amplitude-2 two-sided Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.80. If none passes both panels, select no v0.5 candidate from this family.
confirmatory_policy: Any selected v0.5 candidate must be locked before performance is opened on newly frozen confirmation panels. Passing one panel is insufficient; the pre-frozen confirmation set defined before diagnostic outcome inspection must pass as a conjunction before RGFCA reserve authorization.
